gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-kannada: Flat, stencil-cut, tightly packed. Bevellier draws its heading in one unvarying line, while Anek Kannada, a plain sans with a high, squared-off lowercase, carries paragraphs with open terminals that keep the text from clotting.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vai: Cut-ribbon letters, snug and wide. Bevellier is best at making a heading look graceful and stenciled, whereas Noto Sans Vai, a sans-serif, is best at settling words into solid, approachable blocks.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-radio-canada: Stenciled, graceful, tightly fitted. Bevellier sets a flat, single-weight heading, and Radio Canada, a sans-serif, takes over with tall, full lowercase and open curve endings that keep a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic stays compact and level. Its best quality is how closely it echoes Expose, since both keep x-height near cap height, while the sans body keeps its curve endings well apart.
